content: {"issues":[{"beatId":"beat2","category":"number_wrong_meaning","severity":"advisory","owner":"generator","fields":["board"],"evidence":[{"kind":"label","elementId":"bucket","quote":"capacity"},{"kind":"number","id":"num-1"}],"problem":"The counter labelled \"capacity\" is animated down from 100 to 99 when a token is spent, so the picture says the bucket's capacity shrank, while 99 is the remaining token count and capacity is the fixed maximum (100).","fix":"Relabel the counter as the tokens left in the bucket (keeping 100 → 99) so the falling value reads as the count, not the capacity."},{"beatId":"beat5","category":"visual_contradicts","severity":"blocking","owner":"generator","fields":["board"],"evidence":[{"kind":"label","elementId":"latency","quote":"round trip per request"},{"kind":"number","id":"num-5"},{"kind":"number","id":"num-6"}],"problem":"The latency counter moves from 0.4 to 2.1 as if one round trip got slower, but these are two different points of the same distribution — the median and the p99 — not a change over time.","fix":"Show median and p99 as two separate readouts on the board instead of animating a single counter between them."},{"beatId":"beat7","category":"number_wrong_meaning","severity":"blocking","owner":"generator","fields":["board"],"evidence":[{"kind":"label","elementId":"provider-limit","quote":"provider limit"},{"kind":"number","id":"num-18"},{"kind":"number","id":"num-19"}],"problem":"The counter labelled \"provider limit\" reads 40 req/s and is pinned to the payment provider, but 40 is the number of checkout instances (the multiplier); the provider's contracted rate is 300 requests per second.","fix":"Relabel the counter as \"40× the contracted rate\" with unit \"×\" (or show the contract as 300 req/s) so 40 is not drawn as a rate."}]}
